attributes.name: Oaken Staff
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Melee, or Survival skill + 1d6+1; you may additionally recharge a spell to add another 1d6. 

Reveal this card and discard a spell to reduce all damage dealt to a character at your location by 3. 

When you would discard this card as damage, you may put it on top of your deck instead.
